description: This file defines React components for rendering headings (h1-h6) with specific styles and functionality, including generating anchor links for heading levels 2-4. It includes helper functions, component definitions, and styling for headings used within a React application.

methods.name: getAnchor
methods.description: Generates a URL-friendly slug from the heading text to be used as an anchor ID.

methods.name: Heading
methods.description: Main React component that renders a heading element (h1-h6) with optional link icon and styles.
